newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm as credit rating closer.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm as credit rating closer.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds rose in active trading on Thursday after a two-day correction and profit-taking as the market was buoyed by news Russia's credit rating is due to be announced soon, dealers said.
First Deputy Finance Minister Andrei Vavilov said on Thursday that Russia's credit rating for its forthcoming Eurobond is expected by October 10.
He also said Russia would tighten procedures for registering deals with MinFin bonds before the Eurobond launch.
"After the two days of decline people are buying on this news," Inkombank dealer Alexander Nikolayev said, but added prices had dipped a few times on profit-taking.
Avtobank dealer Ivan Kuznetsov said: "Some demand remained unsatisfied late yesterday and today Russian banks have started to buy, anticipating a further rise."
Dealers said the fourth and the fifth tranches were most actively traded.
They added demand was mainly coming from abroad.
